suite: v15 persistent stash ownership and extraction transactions

results.name: Schema 13 migration preserves bank gold and statistics without fabricating loot
Malformed saves are neutral and canonical item definitions override forged statistics
Restoring items mints unique runtime UIDs while retaining persistent identity
Duplicate persistent item IDs in a saved stash produce one owner
Selection validates slot and class and cannot equip one instance twice
Kit selections survive reload through stable instance identity
Beginning an expedition removes only selected equipment and clears its other-kit references
A second run cannot withdraw more equipment before the active run is settled
Failed kit validation rolls back the complete withdrawal
Extraction deposits physical items and credits loose gold without selling their value
Only an explicit successful sale converts the canonical item value to gold
Supplied gear survives extraction with zero value and cannot be sold
A returned loadout preserves its persistent identity and can be used again
Duplicate references across inventory and equipment are deposited once
An extracted item claiming an already-owned identity cannot duplicate it
Repeated settlement cannot award gold or items twice, including after reload
Unknown or inconsistent run results never alter ownership or balance
Malformed extracted items and invalid gold reject the complete settlement
Inherited object-property names are never treated as canonical item IDs
Malformed item containers cannot silently discard extracted ownership
Exhausted counters and oversized namespaces cannot repeat or freeze identities
Death loses withdrawn equipment while preserving unrelated stash and bank gold
Training never withdraws a selected kit or creates persistent rewards
Cheated normal runs cannot create gold or extracted items
Reloading a pending run forfeits withdrawn equipment exactly once
Reloading an interrupted training run does not count a real run or lose its kit
Selling a selected item clears every kit reference and leaves no phantom equipment
Serialization is detached and omits mutable combat statistics and runtime UIDs
